# anthropic_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists Anthropic organization service accounts (`GET /v1/organizations/service_accounts`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Whether to include archived service accounts in the result list.

### Read-Only

- `service_accounts` (Attributes List) List of organization service accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--service_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was archived, or `null` if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the service account was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the service account, or `null`.
- `id` (String) Unique tagged identifier of the service account (`svac_...`).
- `name` (String) Slug name of the service account.
- `organization_role` (String) Organization-level role assigned to the service account.
- `type` (String) Object type (`service_account`).
